new_decision: Usuário operacional pertence a exatamente um salão; identidades globais de Administrador Atendee permanecem separadas.
security_baseline: Baseline profissional; OWASP ASVS 5.0.0, OWASP multi-tenant e NIST SSDF.
milestone: Starter Kit v7: CI PostgreSQL 18.7 aprovado integralmente em GitHub Actions; 15 domain checks e 9 persistence checks, sem SKIP.
next_blocking_step: Implement ASP.NET Core Identity for operational identities, TOTP/recovery codes, secure cookie and CSRF, plus a server-resolved single-tenant context. Keep platform admin identity separate. Do not enable public signup/email invitations until email delivery is selected.
